frank: Quick sync: platform wants to return a machine-readable v2 error for routing/quota rejects so Console can show "quota exceeded" UX instead of heuristics. Proposal: when client sends header `X-RW-Route-Errors: v2` server returns 409 with structured JSON (code + policy + hint + metadata). Need SDK owners to opt-in and sanity-check impact.
nicole: Can console rely on a stable `code` field? we need that to drive the UI and link to plan pages.
frank: Yes. Example shape (returned only when header present): ```json {"code":"ROUTE_POLICY_VIOLATION","policy":"quota:embed-bulk","allowed":0,"requested":1,"hint":"upgrade","meta":{"tenant":"t-9"}} ``` SDKs should expose a typed error with those fields.
eli: TS SDK: adding `RoutePolicyError` subclass is straightforward. Concern: some clients pattern-match status codes. We'll keep 409 and add the typed class. API: `new Redwood({ routeErrorsV2: 'auto' })` where `auto` enables header negotiation; `true` forces it. Effort ~0.5d.
nicole: Py SDK: same approach, env var `RW_ROUTE_ERRORS_V2` + constructor flag. Ensure `except RedwoodAPIError` still catches the new error. Back-compat: SDK should parse legacy 400 text too.
frank: Rollout plan idea: server feature-flagged; header opt-in for canary (5%). SDKs ship opt-in versions. Console flips header for beta orgs and validates dashboard parsing and resolution links. After telemetry validation, flip defaults internally then public with notice.
eli: Important: do NOT add `Retry-After` for policy rejects; SDKs must not auto-retry on these. Document guidance prominently.
nicole: Telemetry: emit event `route_policy_violation` with fields `code`, `policy`, `tenant_hash`, `sdk` and `frontend`. Sample tenants to protect privacy. Console will show counts, top policies, and resolution links when `hint` present.
frank: SDK checklist: export error class, map fields, constructor/env opt-in, tests for v2 and legacy shapes, changelog + migration notes.
deploy-bot: deploy: feature/route-errors-v2 -> canary started (5% traffic). build ci-8290.
frank: Thanks — tag PRs with `sdk:route-errors-v2` and post small integration test results here. If any blockers surface we'll pause the flip.
